event_text: Downdetector reports of Spotify login problems start to spike
notes: Time as given by TechRadar. Android Authority and Tom's Guide give 5:30 AM ET, Numerama 6:34 AM ET and RIA Novosti 6:32 AM ET; see c008.

event_text: Spotify's status account says it is aware of issues and checking them out
notes: Time of Spotify's own post (s006, 11:56 UTC).

event_text: Downdetector passes 16,500 reports in the US and 8,000 in the UK
notes: Time of TechRadar's live-blog entry (11:58 UTC).

event_text: Spotify's status account says everything is looking much better
notes: Time of Spotify's own post (s007, 12:08 UTC).

event_text: TechRadar reports sign-ins working again for its reporter and many others
Downdetector reports have fallen to about 600, according to Reuters
